label: Secured Finance lending markets exploited; USDFC markets paused to Oct 16
note: Issuer postmortem (2026-10-18): from 2026-09-05 22:11 UTC an order-book red-black-tree bug in the separate fixed-rate Lending Protocol let an attacker withdraw from the TokenVault; impact USD 180,856 at 2026-09-16 valuations, borne by the Foundation. Lending markets, including Filecoin USDFC books, were paused from 2026-09-07 and reopened 2026-10-16; the postmortem says no tokens were minted and no oracle was manipulated. It does not address the core USDFC Trove contracts. Recovery record: https://docs.secured.finance/fixed-rate-lending/contracts-and-security/security-and-incident-reports/incident-recovery-and-verification

label: USDFC switches primary oracle from Pyth to RedStone on Filecoin
note: Issuer upgrade history: after Pyth discontinued Filecoin support, USDFC migrated its primary price oracle to RedStone and upgraded contract parameters through the Filecoin Safe; Blockscout shows both Safe execTransaction calls at blocks 6399930 and 6399939 (2026-09-25 02:45 and 02:49 UTC): https://filecoin.blockscout.com/tx/0xf89996f3e6ec700423cd52292bc7f7b3c0d773d443ab0f059ae7db422adaecda and https://filecoin.blockscout.com/tx/0x498cee683867d99cbc9e19d44dadee5a038565e25a8b45ca89af141827dcb513
